# اِسْتَمْتَعْتِ (istamtaʕti) /is.tam.taʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمْتَعَ (istamtaʕa)
# اِسْتَمْتَعَتْ (istamtaʕat) /is.t
